instructions: Peel the bananas and slice them into the blender. Use ones with brown spots, since they're the sweetest.
Add the 4 cups milk, the 2 tsp vanilla and 3/4 tsp of the cinnamon. If your blender holds less than 6 cups, blend it in two batches.
Blend for about 1 minute, until it's smooth and frothy.
Pour into 4 glasses and dust the tops with the last 1/4 tsp cinnamon. Serve right away.
method_notes: The three versions read are the same drink: banana, milk, vanilla and cinnamon blended smooth. In Mama Maggie's Kitchen (the lead, 5.0 from 41 ratings) the sugar is optional, and a ripe banana is sweet enough, so it is left out here. Cupofyum adds a little agave and Mexican Made Meatless adds ice, and both are optional.
